title: Gas and atmosphere control
tables: O2/CO2 sensing, regulated gas inputs, flow/pressure control and defined exhaust handling.
Creates aerobic, microaerophilic or anaerobic research atmospheres and records exposure history.
Many phenotypes are atmosphere-dependent; research reproducibility requires measured conditions.
External certified gas supply plus controlled valves/flow devices is more controllable than ad-hoc sachets, but containment and exhaust design require biosafety review.
